company.name: Burrow
company.shortDescription: Burrow specialises in premium modular furniture, offering upscale design, durable materials, and direct-to-consumer online convenience.
company.description:
Burrow specializes in selling various luxury furniture online. Its furniture is handcrafted from sturdy, sustainably-sourced hardwood and scratch- and stain-resistant, non-toxic fabrics. Burrow is dedicated to reinventing the way people furnish their homes.

The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in New York.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,906,420 to $173,839,496, a 35.43x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 84 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 57 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
